results.description: Kareena Kapoor Khan and Saif Ali Khan brought their charm to the fourth episode of Koffee With Karan Season 9, making a stylish appearance on the show. While Saif opted for a classic, understated look, Kareena turned up the glamour in a fiery red pantsuit. Host Karan Johar, meanwhile, added his signature dose of luxury with a fashion-forward ensemble and statement accessories.
